observations: Stacked IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) totes, each with a white/translucent plastic inner container held in a galvanized steel cage frame.
Containers sit on pallets (material not clearly visible, could be steel, plastic or wood).
Hazard diamond warning labels are visible on the inner containers in both photos, but the text/pictograms are too small to read.
Black plastic outlet valves/caps visible at the base of each cage.
Photos taken outdoors in daylight, units appear weathered/used rather than factory-new, with visible stacking and handling marks.
A watermark 'JT BATHROOMS AND...POSTED ON JIJI' overlays photo 1.
No photo shows a close-up of the valve, the pallet base, or the inner bladder surface for cracks or stress marks.

identity.kind: IBC tank (1000L intermediate bulk container, tote)

claims.claim: "An IBC tank typically consists of three primary components: Inner Container... " (generic description of IBC tank construction)
claims.evidence: This is a generic textbook description of IBC tanks in general, not a specific claim about the condition or history of the units pictured; photos do not confirm or deny it.

risks.risk: Prior chemical/hazardous content residue inside the inner container (hazard diamonds are visible but unreadable)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the hazard label/diamond and any stenciled product name on the tank
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/possibly contaminated, lowering value versus food-grade or virgin tanks

risks.risk: Condition of inner plastic bladder (stress cracks, UV brittleness, cloudiness from age)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the tank walls in good light, plus a photo with water/liquid inside to show no leaks
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed sound, i.e. as a used tank of unknown integrity

risks.risk: Functionality and seal of the bottom outlet valve
risks.proof: A photo or short video of the valve opening and closing, ideally with liquid flow

risks.risk: Condition and material of the pallet base (steel pallets are more durable/valuable than wood)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the pallet base from underneath or the side
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower end assuming a basic/wood pallet

risks.risk: Rust or structural damage to the steel cage frame
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the cage welds and bars, especially corners
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming some surface rust/wear, not new condition

risks.risk: Actual capacity (1000L is standard but could be a smaller/larger variant)
risks.proof: Photo of the capacity markings/plate on the tank

proof_requests: Close-up of the hazard diamond label and any product stencil on the inner container
Close-up of the outlet valve, ideally a short clip showing it opening/closing
Photo of the pallet base material and condition
Photo of the capacity/markings plate on the tank
Close-up of the inner container walls for cracks, discoloration, or cloudiness
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as used IBC tanks (1000L totes) by type from the photos; lacking proof of valve function, inner bladder integrity, and prior contents, they must be priced at worst-case as used/unverified-condition tanks rather than premium food-grade or new units.
